curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What deep bond brought an enigmatic Frenchman across national borders to mourn at a fallen soldier's grave?
curatedMovie.description: In post-World War I Germany, a young woman mourning the death of her fiancé in France encounters an enigmatic French soldier quietly leaving flowers at the fallen man's grave.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Slow, thoughtful, and emotionally heavy drama that rewards patient, engaged viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director François Ozon delivers a delicate, emotionally resonant period drama, exploring grief and cross-border reconciliation with patient elegance.
